sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module aims to demonstrate the underlying importance of symmetry throughout Chemistry, with particular applications to spectroscopic selection rules and bonding in inorganic chemistry.
sections.Learning outcomes: A analyze the symmetry properties of molecules and assign molecules to their correct point groups B predict and relate aspects of molecular/ complex structure and bonding C critically discuss the fundamental role of molecular symmetry in determining molecular/complex properties and reactivity D use character tables to solve a variety of problems in spectroscopy
